name: tless
description: T-LESS is a dataset for 6D pose estimation of texture-less industrial objects. It provides RGB(-D) images and CAD models of multiple objects under varied viewpoints and lighting, and is commonly used to benchmark object detection and 6D pose estimation methods. The dataset is part of the BOP benchmark ecosystem and is aimed at evaluating methods under realistic, texture-poor conditions.
evaluation_method: pose-error metrics (ADD / ADD-S, VSD) often summarized as Average Recall (AR) or recall@pose-error-threshold
general_score_metric: Average Recall (AR) computed over pose-error metrics (e.g., VSD / ADD(-S))
reputation: Widely used and well-regarded in the 6D pose estimation and BOP communities as a challenging benchmark for texture-less objects.
